name: M5 heat-set insert (CNC Kitchen M5 x 9.5)
summary: Brass insert melted into a printed part. Needs a 6.5 mm hole at least 10.5 mm deep.
source: CNC Kitchen metric insert table: M5 x 9.5 is 9.5 mm long and 7.1 mm across the knurl, wants a 6.5 mm hole at least 10.5 mm deep and at least 2.6 mm of plastic around the hole. Other brands of the same nominal size differ by a few tenths, so test-fit one before printing a whole enclosure.
